svg.desc: Egypt's National Universities LOCATION Several cities across Egypt CLIENT Ministry of Higher Education COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2020 30 billion EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Project Overview Completed in 2020 across several Egyptian cities, the project delivered urban and landscape design for national universities. The work introduced local planting, courts, pergolas, shaded structures and food courts to improve comfort and the student experience. BECT provided urban planning and landscape design services for the Ministry of Higher Education.
